shipping.title: The finer details.
shipping.body:
Orders are dispatched from our studio within 24–48 hours via insured express couriers. Delivery usually takes 2–4 business days across India, and you'll receive tracking by SMS and email.

If a piece isn't right, message our concierge within 7 days of delivery. Unworn pieces in their original pouch with tags are eligible for a return or exchange. Made-to-order pieces and pierced-earring hygiene exclusions may apply.

privacy.title: Your privacy matters.
privacy.body:
Your bag and saved pieces are stored in your browser. Account, order and delivery details are used only to fulfil your order and are never sold.

Payments are processed by Razorpay. We do not store card details. You can request deletion of your account and data at any time through our support concierge.

care.title: Keep the shine.
care.body:
Keep imitation jewellery away from water, perfume and harsh chemicals. Wipe gently with a soft, dry cloth after wearing and store each piece separately in a dry pouch.

Follow the product-specific care card included with your order. With a little care, your favourite pieces stay lovely for longer.
